baseline.state: visualizing-work is a broad 7,030-byte entry that selects formal visual artifacts through reader, question, evidence, artifact-contract, and evaluation references
baseline.limitation: It does not provide a short dedicated entry for inline pseudocode, call/component/file trees, and shape-aware diffs requested with show-me wording

candidate.state: A 4,611-byte review entry owns quick inline visual explanations, hands document-shaped HTML to creating-html-documents with a bounded brief, and returns non-recursive local slices when the document owner calls it

outcome_rubric.pass: Quick visual requests select the smallest inline form; document-shaped HTML hands off through a bounded visual brief; document-owned calls return only a local slice; roadmap and detailed diagrams hand off to existing owners; nonvisual requests do not route here.
outcome_rubric.fail: A visual request is missed, a nonvisual request triggers, show-me owns a long-form HTML document, or either skill recursively delegates document ownership.

reviewer.limitation: Deterministic instruction and routing review only; no long-term usage telemetry or independently sampled model benchmark.
